body.zh-Hant: 林科米斯1894年12月22日生於維堡，1963年9月8日卒於赫爾辛基。他任赫爾辛基大學羅馬文學教授，曾任副校長（1932–1943）、校長（1956–1962）與名譽校長（1962–1963）。政治上，他1918年隨國民聯盟黨成立而起步，1933至1945年任國會議員，1933至1943年任副議長，1943至1944年任首相；據來源，他是在出任首相時才成為黨主席。
body.en: Linkomies was born in Viipuri on 22 December 1894 and died in Helsinki on 8 September 1963. He was Professor of Roman Letters at the University of Helsinki, Vice-rector 1932–1943, Rector 1956–1962 and Chancellor 1962–1963. His political career began in 1918 with the founding of the National Coalition Party; he was an MP 1933–1945, Deputy Speaker 1933–1943 and Prime Minister 1943–1944, and by the source's account became party chairman only on his appointment as prime minister.

body.en: Renkin was born in Ixelles on 3 December 1862 and died in Brussels on 15 July 1934. A lawyer and Christian-democratic politician, he took a doctorate in law at Leuven in 1884 and sat as deputy for Brussels from 1896 to 1934. He was Minister of Justice (1907–08), Colonies (1908–18), Railways, Posts and Telegraphs (1918–19), Interior (1919–20 and 1931–32) and Finance (1932), and prime minister from June 1931 to October 1932; he was made Minister of State in 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 斯巴克1899年1月25日生於斯卡爾貝克，1921年成為布魯塞爾律師。他加入社會黨，1932年當選眾議員；1935年范澤蘭任首相時出任郵電暨交通部長，1936年任外交部長，1937年在保羅－埃米爾·揚松內閣續任。1938年5月15日他出任首相並兼外交部長。在皮埃洛內閣，他仍主管外交，1940年隨政府流亡倫敦。
body.en: Spaak was born in Schaerbeek on 25 January 1899 and became a Brussels lawyer in 1921. He joined the Socialist Party and was elected deputy in 1932; in 1935, under prime minister Van Zeeland, he became Minister of Posts, Telegraphs and Transport, in 1936 Foreign Minister, retaining that office in the Paul-Émile Janson cabinet in 1937. On 15 May 1938 he became prime minister while keeping foreign affairs. Under the Pierlot cabinet he again held Foreign Affairs and went to London with the government in 1940.

heading.en: Early life and career in Austria

body.zh-Hant: 克拉馬日1860年12月27日生於上亞日爾河畔瓦索凱（Vysoké nad Jizerou），1884年在布拉格取得法學學位。1890年他與馬薩里克、凱茨爾加入青年捷克黨；1891年當選帝國議會下院議員，任至哈布斯堡王朝覆亡。1894年他當選波希米亞邦議會議員，任至1913年。1897年起任青年捷克黨主席，並先後成為帝國議會下院的第二、第一副議長。
body.en: Kramář was born on 27 December 1860 in Vysoké nad Jizerou and graduated in law at Prague in 1884. In 1890 he joined the Young Czech Party with Masaryk and Kaizl. Elected to the Chamber of Deputies in 1891, he sat until the fall of the Habsburg Monarchy; in 1894 he was also elected to the Bohemian Provincial Assembly, serving until 1913. In 1897 he became chairperson of the Young Czech Party and, successively, second and then first deputy chairperson of the Reichsrat's Chamber of Deputies.

body.zh-Hant: 1915年5月，克拉馬日被捕，並與阿洛伊斯·拉辛一同被控叛國。判決於1916年6月3日下達，兩人被判死刑，但皇帝弗朗茨·約瑟夫未簽署；新皇帝卡爾一世將死刑改為20年徒刑。1917年7月他獲大赦出獄。
body.en: Kramář was arrested in May 1915 and, with Alois Rašín, charged with treason. The verdict was handed down on 3 June 1916 and both were sentenced to death, but Emperor Franz Joseph did not sign it; the new Emperor Charles I commuted the sentence to 20 years in prison. Kramář was released under an amnesty in July 1917.

heading.zh-Hant: 民族委員會、首相任期與晚年
heading.en: National Committee, premiership and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1918年夏，克拉馬日當選捷克政治中樞「民族委員會」的主席。1918年11月14日，首屆捷克斯洛伐克議會選他為政府首腦；1919年1月他以首相身分率代表團赴巴黎和會。1919年7月8日，他的政府倒台，此後他仍任議員直至去世。他於1937年5月26日卒於布拉格。
body.en: In the summer of 1918 Kramář was elected head of the National Committee, the central body of Czech politics. On 14 November 1918 the first Czechoslovak parliament elected him chairperson of the government; in January 1919 he went to the Paris Peace Conference as prime minister and head of the delegation. His government fell on 8 July 1919; he remained a member of parliament until his death in Prague on 26 May 1937.

people.nameZh: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·本略赫·伊·比沃

heading.en: Life and ecclesiastical career in outline

body.zh-Hant: 本略赫生於瓦倫西亞，曾任塞戈維亞總主教代理（1900）、索爾索納主教暨宗座署理（1901）。1906至1919年任烏赫爾主教，因而成為安道爾共同親王；據來源，他推動1913年修築烏赫爾城至安道爾老城的道路，並創辦工人學院。1919年他成為布爾戈斯總主教，1921年晉升樞機。
body.en: Benlloch was born in Valencia and became vicar general of Segovia (1900) and bishop and apostolic administrator of Solsona (1901). He was Bishop of Urgell 1906–1919, which made him co-prince of Andorra; the source credits him with the 1913 road between La Seu d'Urgell and Andorra la Vella and with founding the Institut Obrer. In 1919 he became Archbishop of Burgos and in 1921 a cardinal.
